text: Implement axis-aligned Gaussian only: explicit typed sigmaX/sigmaY, shared separable convolution and existing source-side edge correction. KernelBandwidth distinguishes Isotropic from AxisAligned rather than inventing a scalar proxy; this is a source migration for custom Smoother implementations/bandwidth readers. Gaussian provenance and supported numerical behavior remain unchanged; anisotropic resolution checks each axis against its own cell side. KernelSupportOverflow prevents unrepresentable array support before allocation. StudyEstimate, recipe inspection, plan/result codecs and diagnostics carry both widths. Contrast CSV schema /2 appends sigma_x/sigma_y; sigma remains for isotropic rows only. Old Gaussian plan payloads remain readable. No automatic covariance fitting, rotation, adaptive/foveal kernel or anisotropic Pyramid is claimed. Independent direct 2-D oracle and transpose tests killed the intentional sigmaY-to-sigmaX mutant (4 failures); source restored to SHA-256 7fed4e4ba1b31c33925f3085535326bac5598147b873016b6c0d12d32fb832c7.
